title: (To be deprecated) Metrics in Legacy Smart+ Campaign reports
content_data:
Below are the supported metrics for Smart+ Campaign reports. ## Basic data ```xtable | Metric {20%} | Type{15%} | Description {15%} |Detail {50%} | |----------|------|-------------|--------------| | spend | string | Total cost | The estimated total amount of money you've spent on your campaign, ad group or ad during its schedule. | | cpc | string | CPC (Destination) | The average amount of money to a specified destination costs you. | | cpm | string | CPM | The average amount of money you've spent per 1,000 impressions. | | impressions | string | Impressions | The number of times your ads were on screen. | | clicks | string | Clicks (Destination) | The number of clicks from your ads that lead to specified destinations. | | ctr | string | CTR (Destination) | The percentage of times people click to a specified destination after being shown your ad. | | conversion | string | Conversions | The number of times your ad achieved an outcome, based on the objective and settings you selected.
The total count is calculated based on the time each ad impression occurred. | | cost_per_conversion | string | CPA | The average amount of money you've spent on a conversion.
The total count is calculated based on the time each ad impression occurred. | | conversion_rate | string | CVR (Clicks) | The percentage of conversions from all clicks on your ads. The metric will be removed soon.
The total count is calculated based on the time each ad impression occurred. | | conversion_rate_v2 | string | CVR (Impressions) | The percentage of conversions from all impressions on your ads.
The total count is calculated based on the time each ad impression occurred. | | real_time_conversion | string | Real-time Conversions | The number of times your ad achieved an outcome based on the objective and settings you selected.
The total count is based on when the conversion actually happened. | | real_time_cost_per_conversion | string | Real-time CPA | The average amount of money you've spent on a conversion.
The total count is based on when the conversion actually happened. | | real_time_conversion_rate | string | Real-time CVR (Clicks) | The percentage of conversions from all clicks on your ads. This metric will be removed soon .
The total count is based on when the conversion actually happened. | | real_time_conversion_rate_v2 | string | Real-time CVR (Impressions) | The percentage of conversions from all impressions on your ads.
The total count is based on when the conversion actually happened. | | secondary_goal_result | string | Secondary goal result | The number of times your ad achieved an outcome, based on the secondary goal you selected. As one campaign may have a number of different secondary goals, this statistic is not supported for campaigns. Please go to ad groups or ads to view.
The total count is calculated based on the time each ad impression occurred. | | cost_per_secondary_goal_result | string | Cost per secondary goal result | The average cost for each secondary goal result from your adverts. As one campaign may have a number of different secondary goals, this statistic is not supported for campaigns. Please go to ad groups or ads to view.
The total count is calculated based on the time each ad impression occurred. | | secondary_goal_result_rate | string | Secondary goal result rate | The percentage of secondary goal results you achieved out of all of the installs of your adverts. As one campaign may have a number of different secondary goals, this statistic is not supported for campaigns. Please go to ad groups or ads to view.
The total count is calculated based on the time each ad impression occurred. | | skan_conversion | string | Conversions (SKAN) | The number of times your ad achieved an outcome based on the objective and settings you selected.
The total count is based on when the events are returned through the SKAdNetwork API. There may be a delay between the actual conversion time and when the conversion is reported. | | skan_cost_per_conversion | string | CPA (SKAN) | The average amount of money you've spent on a conversion.
The total count is based on when the events are returned through the SKAdNetwork API. There may be a delay between the actual conversion time and when the conversion is reported. | | skan_conversion_rate | string | CVR (SKAN, clicks) | The percentage of conversions from all clicks of your ads. Data may be incomplete due to SKAdNetwork (SKAN) limitations. This metric will be removed soon.
The total count is based on when the events are returned through the SKAdNetwork API. There may be a delay between the actual conversion time and when the conversion is reported.
Note:
Starting late October, 2023, the calculation logic for this metric will be updated to be impression-based (the same as `skan_conversion_rate_v2`). To ensure a smooth API integration and avoid disruptions caused by the change in calculation logic, we recommend you switch to using the impression-based metric `skan_conversion_rate_v2` as soon as possible. | | skan_conversion_rate_v2 | string | CVR (SKAN, impressions) | The percentage of conversions from all impressions on your ads. Data may be incomplete due to SKAdNetwork (SKAN) limitations.
The total count is based on when the events are returned through the SKAdNetwork API. There may be a delay between the actual conversion time and when the conversion is reported. | ``` ## Video play ```xtable | Metric {20%} | Type{15%} | Description {15%} |Detail {50%} | |----------|------|-------------|--------------| | video_play_actions | string | Video Views | The number of times someone started playing your video. Replays will not be counted. | | video_watched_2s | string | 2-second video Views | The number of times your video played for at least 2 seconds. Replays will not be counted. | | video_watched_6s | string | 6-second video Views | The number of times your video played for at least 6 seconds, or played in full. Replays will not be counted. | | video_views_p100 | string | Video Views at 100% | The number of times your video was played at 100% of its length. Replays will not be counted. | | video_views_p75 | string | Video Views at 75% | The number of times your video was played at 75% of its duration. Replays will not be counted. | | video_views_p50 | string | Video Views at 50% | The number of times your video was played at 50% of its duration. Replays will not be counted. Data from Pangle is currently not supported. | | video_views_p25 | string | Video Views at 25% | The number of times your video was played at 25% of its duration. Replays will not be counted. Data from Pangle is currently not supported. | | average_video_play | string | Average Watch Time per Video View | The average time your video was played per single video view, including any time spent replaying the video. | ``` ## Interaction ```xtable | Metric {20%} | Type{15%} | Description {15%} |Detail {50%} | |----------|------|-------------|--------------| | follows | string | Paid followers | The number of new followers that were gained within 1 day of a user seeing a paid ad.
